teaser.en: The wild kapok: a slippery-barked giant whose pods burst into red-brown fluff and whose roasted seeds taste like groundnuts.
teaser.sw: Msufi mwitu: jitu lenye gome linaloteleza, ambalo maganda yake hupasuka na kutoa sufi ya rangi nyekundu-kahawia, na mbegu zake zilizokaangwa zina ladha kama karanga.

summary.en: Msufi mwitu, also called Mware, is the East African bombax, a tall forest tree whose capsules release seeds in fluffy kapok. It gives soft timber for canoes, drums and carving, and its seeds can be roasted and eaten.
summary.sw: Msufi mwitu, unaoitwa pia Mware, ni mti mrefu wa msituni ambao vifuko vyake hutoa mbegu ndani ya sufi laini. Hutoa mbao laini za kutengenezea mitumbwi, ngoma na vinyago, na mbegu zake zinaweza kukaangwa na kuliwa.

about.en: Mware is a tall tree, up to about 36 m, with a straight trunk and smooth yellow-green bark. Its leaves are divided like the fingers of a hand into three to seven leaflets. The flowers have five pale yellow, red or white petals and many red stamens. The fruit is a woody brown capsule about 6 cm long that splits to free many seeds wrapped in red-brown kapok. The Digo recognise it by its leaves and its stem, whose bark they call ereza, slippery.
about.sw: Mware ni mti mrefu, hadi takriban mita 36, wenye shina lililonyooka na gome laini la rangi ya manjano-kijani. Majani yake yamegawanyika kama vidole vya mkono katika vijani vitatu hadi saba. Maua yana petali tano za manjano hafifu, nyekundu au nyeupe, na stameni nyingi nyekundu. Tunda ni kifuko kigumu cha kahawia chenye urefu wa takriban sentimita 6, kinachopasuka na kuachilia mbegu nyingi zilizofunikwa kwa sufi ya rangi nyekundu-kahawia. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake na shina lake, ambalo gome lake wanaliita ereza, linaloteleza.

where.en: In Kenya it grows only near the coast, in evergreen forest, forest margins and remnants and coastal bushland, from sea level to about 350 m. It prefers clay but also grows on soils over coral, as in the kaya forests and Shimba Hills of Kwale.
where.sw: Nchini Kenya huota karibu na pwani tu, katika misitu ya kijani kibichi kwa mwaka mzima, pembezoni mwa misitu na mabaki ya misitu, na katika vichaka vya pwani, kutoka usawa wa bahari hadi takriban mita 350. Hupendelea udongo wa mfinyanzi lakini pia huota kwenye udongo ulio juu ya matumbawe, kama katika misitu ya kaya na Shimba Hills ya Kwale.

uses.en: ICRAF records soft timber used for carving, canoes and drums, and a bark fibre and red-brown dye. The kapok is used to stuff pillows and mattresses. The seeds can be roasted and eaten like groundnuts, or pounded and cooked with vegetables or meat, and hollows in the trunk are used to store dry food and honey. Bark and leaves are used in medicine, and the tree is planted for shade and as a boundary marker.
uses.sw: ICRAF inarekodi mbao laini zinazotumika kuchonga vinyago, kutengeneza mitumbwi na ngoma, pamoja na nyuzi za gome na rangi ya nyekundu-kahawia. Sufi hutumika kujaza mito na magodoro. Mbegu zinaweza kukaangwa na kuliwa kama karanga, au kutwangwa na kupikwa pamoja na mboga au nyama, na mashimo ya shina hutumika kuhifadhia chakula kikavu na asali. Gome na majani hutumika kama dawa, na mti hupandwa kwa ajili ya kivuli na kama alama ya mpaka.

culture.en: The name Msufi mwitu makes it the wild cousin of the cultivated kapok tree, Msufi. Pakia notes that sufi (kapok) and pamba (cotton) are names for woolly fruits, applied to both the grown plants and their wild relatives.
culture.sw: Jina Msufi mwitu linaufanya kuwa ndugu wa porini wa msufi unaopandwa, Msufi. Pakia anaeleza kwamba sufi na pamba ni majina ya matunda yenye nyuzi kama sufu, yanayotumika kwa mimea inayopandwa na kwa jamaa zao wa porini pia.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names: Msufi mwitu, 'wild kapok', and Mware, which is shared with Duruma and Giriama. In Swahili it is msufi mwitu or mkaranga mti. In English it is the East African bombax, wild kapok or East African cotton tree; its scientific name is Bombax rhodognaphalon.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo: Msufi mwitu, 'msufi wa porini', na Mware, linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa msufi mwitu au mkaranga mti. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *East African bombax*, *wild kapok* au *East African cotton tree*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Bombax rhodognaphalon.

definition.en: The woolly fruit of kapok trees, both the planted kapok and the wild msufi mwitu. Probably borrowed from Arabic through Swahili.
definition.sw: Tunda lenye nyuzi kama sufu la misufi, msufi unaopandwa na msufi mwitu wa porini pia. Huenda limetoholewa kutoka Kiarabu kupitia Kiswahili.
